Our Available Poodles

Dogs in our rescue change frequently. Although we have many more dogs in our foster homes than those you see here, they are not added to our website until they have been evaluated by their foster parents, received needed veterinary care, and are ready for adoption. Some dogs are adopted before they are added to this page.

We work diligently to match each dog with the right family.  We are advocates for our dogs.  We adopt to homes where we believe our dogs will thrive and blossom.  If you are interested in adopting, please complete an application at https://www.floridapoodlerescue.org/adoption-application/. Our volunteers will be in touch if we have a dog that we believe will match your requirements and living circumstances.

Thank you for considering Florida Poodle Rescue for your next family member!
